scope: Synthetic non-personal test scenarios; use actual generated intermediate replies, not scripted assistant answers.
procedure: Align and record exact deployed commit, owner/project, provider/model, surface and prompt contract fingerprint.
Replay each sequence with actual intervening assistant responses; do not coach the model with rubric text.
Compare the prior candidate and this candidate on the same model/settings. Keep original transcripts and active request inclusion evidence.
For memory cases, independently record stored/retrieved/request-included evidence. Run both present and absent evidence conditions, plus restart and foreign-scope denial.
For real exemplar comparison, use the privately reviewed corpus only after scoped consent and privacy review. Original keyword flags do not clear examples automatically.
Judge contextual contribution, useful questions, independent judgment, correction retention and task completion. Do not count profanity, emojis, nicknames or copied punch lines as success.
Record pass, fail or unknown by dimension with the actual reply as evidence. A single successful exchange does not establish enduring parity.
Repeat tired/terse and sensitive conditions, fresh sessions, text/voice transitions and Grove on the intended host. Microphone/acoustics and protected deployments wait until the user is home.

externalEvidenceCriteria identifies rubric indices requiring independently inspected host/tool/storage/restart/audio receipts. The offline audit checks presence only, never authenticates supplied claims.
